# CatppuccinRGB565 — Full Documentation & API Reference

> Catppuccin color palette (all 4 flavors: Mocha, Macchiato, Frappé, Latte; all 26 colors) pre-converted to RGB565 for Arduino, ESP32, TFT, and OLED display libraries.

- **Repository**: https://github.com/nicholaswilde/catppuccin-rgb565
- **License**: Apache-2.0
- **Language**: C++ (C++11 or higher)
- **Format**: RGB565 (16-bit unsigned integer: 5-bit Red, 6-bit Green, 5-bit Blue)
- **Byte Order**: Big-endian host format

---

## 1. Installation

### PlatformIO
In your project's `platformio.ini`:
```ini
[env:esp32]
platform = espressif32
board = esp32dev
framework = arduino
lib_deps =
    https://github.com/nicholaswilde/catppuccin-rgb565.git
```

### Arduino IDE
Download the repository zip from GitHub and install it via **Sketch > Include Library > Add .ZIP Library...**, or clone into your `Arduino/libraries/` folder:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/nicholaswilde/catppuccin-rgb565.git CatppuccinRGB565
```

---

## 2. Color Values Reference Table (RGB565 & Hex)

### 2.1 Mocha (Dark Theme, `#1E1E2E` Base)
| Color Name | RGB565 (Hex) | Hex 24-bit | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `rosewater` | `0xF71B` | `#F5E0DC` | Warm highlight / rose |
| `flamingo` | `0xF679` | `#F2CDCD` | Soft coral |
| `pink` | `0xF61C` | `#F5C2E7` | Light pink accent |
| `mauve` | `0xCD3E` | `#CBA6F7` | Violet / purple accent |
| `red` | `0xF455` | `#F38BA8` | Error / danger |
| `maroon` | `0xED15` | `#EBA0AC` | Soft brick red |
| `peach` | `0xFD90` | `#FAB387` | Orange accent |
| `yellow` | `0xFF15` | `#F9E2AF` | Warning / yellow accent |
| `green` | `0xA714` | `#A6E3A1` | Success / green accent |
| `teal` | `0x971A` | `#94E2D5` | Turquoise / teal accent |
| `sky` | `0x8EFD` | `#89DCEB` | Light sky blue |
| `sapphire` | `0x763D` | `#74C7EC` | Vibrant sapphire blue |
| `blue` | `0x8DBF` | `#89B4FA` | Primary blue accent |
| `lavender` | `0xB5FF` | `#B4BEFE` | Periwinkle / lavender |
| `text` | `0xCEBE` | `#CDD6F4` | Primary body text |
| `subtext1` | `0xBE1B` | `#BAC2DE` | High-contrast subtext |
| `subtext0` | `0xA579` | `#A6ADC8` | Low-contrast subtext |
| `overlay2` | `0x94D6` | `#9399B2` | Borders, highlights |
| `overlay1` | `0x7C33` | `#7F849C` | Subtle dividers |
| `overlay0` | `0x6B90` | `#6C7086` | Inactive elements |
| `surface2` | `0x5ACE` | `#585B70` | Active card / surface |
| `surface1` | `0x422B` | `#45475A` | Elevated surface |
| `surface0` | `0x3188` | `#313244` | Panel surface |
| `base` | `0x18E5` | `#1E1E2E` | Default background |
| `mantle` | `0x18C4` | `#181825` | Darker recessed background |
| `crust` | `0x1083` | `#11111B` | Deepest crust background |

## 3. C++ API Reference

### 3.1 Namespaces & Enums
```cpp
namespace Catppuccin {

enum class Flavor : uint8_t {
    Mocha      = 0,
    Macchiato  = 1,
    Frappe     = 2,
    Latte      = 3,
};

namespace Mocha     { /* 26 constexpr uint16_t colors */ }
namespace Macchiato { /* 26 constexpr uint16_t colors */ }
namespace Frappe    { /* 26 constexpr uint16_t colors */ }
namespace Latte     { /* 26 constexpr uint16_t colors */ }

struct Palette {
    uint16_t rosewater, flamingo, pink, mauve, red, maroon;
    uint16_t peach, yellow, green, teal, sky, sapphire;
    uint16_t blue, lavender, text, subtext1, subtext0;
    uint16_t overlay2, overlay1, overlay0;
    uint16_t surface2, surface1, surface0;
    uint16_t base, mantle, crust;
};

const Palette& getPalette(Flavor flavor);

} // namespace Catppuccin
```

### 3.2 Byte Swapping Macros
For SPI/DMA display drivers expecting swapped endianness:
```cpp
#define CATP_SWAP(c)   ((uint16_t)(((c) >> 8) | ((c) << 8)))
#define CATP_SWAP16(c) CATP_SWAP(c)
```

---

## 4. Usage Examples with Display Libraries

### 4.1 TFT_eSPI (Static Palette)
```cpp
#include <TFT_eSPI.h>
#include <CatppuccinRGB565.h>

TFT_eSPI tft = TFT_eSPI();

void setup() {
    tft.init();
    tft.setRotation(1);

    // Dark Mocha background
    tft.fillScreen(Catppuccin::Mocha::base);

    // Text header
    tft.setTextColor(Catppuccin::Mocha::text, Catppuccin::Mocha::base);
    tft.drawString("Sensor Dashboard", 10, 10, 4);

    // Status card
    tft.fillRoundRect(10, 50, 140, 80, 6, Catppuccin::Mocha::surface0);
    tft.drawRoundRect(10, 50, 140, 80, 6, Catppuccin::Mocha::mauve);
    tft.setTextColor(Catppuccin::Mocha::green, Catppuccin::Mocha::surface0);
    tft.drawString("Status: OK", 20, 80, 2);
}

void loop() {}
```

### 4.2 Adafruit_GFX (Dynamic Runtime Theme)
```cpp
#include <Adafruit_GFX.h>
#include <Adafruit_ST7789.h>
#include <CatppuccinRGB565.h>

extern Adafruit_ST7789 display;

void renderUI(Catppuccin::Flavor theme) {
    const Catppuccin::Palette& p = Catppuccin::getPalette(theme);

    display.fillScreen(p.base);
    display.setTextColor(p.text);
    display.setTextSize(2);
    display.setCursor(20, 20);
    display.print("Current Theme");

    display.fillRect(20, 60, 40, 40, p.blue);
    display.fillRect(70, 60, 40, 40, p.peach);
    display.fillRect(120, 60, 40, 40, p.green);
}
```

### 4.3 LovyanGFX
```cpp
#include <LovyanGFX.hpp>
#include <CatppuccinRGB565.h>

LGFX lcd;

void setup() {
    lcd.init();
    lcd.setRotation(1);

    lcd.fillScreen(Catppuccin::Latte::base);
    lcd.setTextColor(Catppuccin::Latte::text);
    lcd.drawCenterString("Latte Theme", lcd.width() / 2, 20, &fonts::Font4);
}

void loop() {}
```
